name: Govee Controller
author: oparada1988
short_description: Control Govee smart lights, LED strips, scenes, and home appliances from your Stream Deck.
description:
Connect your Govee smart lighting and home appliances directly to your Stream Deck.

Toggle device power, adjust brightness levels, set custom RGB colors, and trigger preset lighting scenes with instant visual feedback.

actions.name: Power Toggle
actions.description: Turn Govee lights and smart appliances on or off

actions.name: Brightness Control
actions.description: Set or step light brightness percentages

actions.name: Color Picker
actions.description: Apply custom RGB color presets with one press

actions.name: Scene Trigger
actions.description: Activate built-in Govee lighting scenes and effects
